WordPress flooded with casino spam posts (19/20 latest)
Declared XML sitemaps return empty bodies
Default OG image is SVG (social + some crawlers ignore)

quick_wins: Restore HTML or cut over to Next SSR

categories.name: Live Production Incident
what_works: wp-json API still responds with brand name

findings.title: Empty HTML body on all public HTML routes
findings.description: Homepage, locale paths, and sitemap XML return 200 with 0-byte bodies. Playwright render extracts no text.
findings.recommendation: Fix WP Rocket/theme output or cut over to Next.js immediately; use 503 during migration if needed.

findings.title: Casino spam content takeover
findings.description: 19 of 20 most recent WP posts are gambling/casino affiliate content under business-small-business (63 posts).
findings.recommendation: Delete spam, remove category, audit users/plugins, rotate secrets, request GSC removals for spam URLs.

findings.title: Sitemaps empty / invalid
findings.description: sitemap_index.xml, sitemap.xml, and wp-sitemap.xml return empty responses despite robots declaration.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate sitemaps or point robots to Next sitemap_index.xml after cutover.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Next apps/web has robots.ts, multi-file sitemaps, SSR, locale middleware

findings.title: AI crawler policy missing on live; added in Next
findings.description: Live robots is WooCommerce default. Next robots.ts now allows GPTBot/OAI-SearchBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended and blocks training scrapers.
findings.recommendation: Deploy Next robots with site cutover; document AI crawler policy in ops runbook.

findings.title: Unconditional hreflang for fa/en
findings.description: pageMetadata and sitemaps always advertise both locales even when translation is missing.
findings.recommendation: Emit alternates only when a real translation exists; noindex incomplete locale URLs.

categories.name: Content / E-E-A-T
what_works: Docs content is structured and citable
Historical JS lessons still exist in WP API archive

findings.title: Article detail missing visible date/author
findings.description: publishedAt only in metadata; no byline or time element in article UI.
findings.recommendation: Render localized publish/update dates and author credentials on article pages.

findings.title: Thin podcasts placeholder was indexable
findings.description: Empty-state podcasts page was in misc sitemap without noindex.
findings.recommendation: noIndex until content ships (applied in this PR).

categories.name: Schema
what_works: Organization, WebSite+SearchAction, Breadcrumb, Article CMS schema, docs TechArticle/LearningResource

findings.title: Course schema missing offers/instance
findings.description: Course JSON-LD lacked hasCourseInstance and Offer fields required for richer eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Emit offers + CourseInstance (applied in this PR); add instructor when available.

findings.title: Category ItemList used relative URLs
findings.description: ItemList elements overwrote API URLs with relative paths missing locale.

categories.name: GEO / AI Search
what_works: Next SSR enables AI crawler readability
Docs have definition-first passages and sources

findings.title: Live site unusable for AI citation
findings.description: Empty HTML means GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Googlebot get nothing to quote.
findings.recommendation: Restore SSR HTML first; then optimize passages on top money pages.

findings.title: llms.txt missing on live; added in Next public/
findings.description: Google ignores llms.txt for ranking; useful for some non-Google assistants.
findings.recommendation: Keep llms.txt updated with hubs; do not treat as Google ranking lever.

findings.title: Weak brand entity packaging
findings.description: Organization.sameAs empty; social channels mentioned in copy but not linked in schema.
findings.recommendation: Fill ORGANIZATION_SAME_AS with real profile URLs; pursue Wikipedia/Wikidata if eligible.

findings.title: Default OG is SVG
findings.recommendation: Add og-default.png 1200x630 and update seo.ts + Organization logo.

findings.title: Empty alt on content images
findings.description: Cards and banners commonly use alt="".
findings.recommendation: Set alt from title/CMS alt field.
